title: Naam hai nek naam fizza ka
body:
Naam hai nekh naam fizza ka
Aayate hai kalaam fizza ka
Qidmate haq hai kaam fizza ka
Rab se pucho maqaam fiza ka
<<MINI>>
Sar se paa tak salaam hai fizza
Wajib ul ehteraam hai fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo madeene me aayi thi jis dam
Us pe taari thi bekasi ka alam
Tha aseeri ka us ko gham paiham
Us pe barsa nabi ka abre karam
<<MINI>>
Naam us ka rasool ne rakhha
Apne ghar me batool ne rakkha
<<DIVIDER>>
Us ko qismat ali ke ghar laayi
Chod kar wo shahinshaahi aayi
Us se meraaj e haq rasi paayi
Fatima ki kaneez kehlaayi
<<MINI>>
Us ka rutba buland o baala hai
Chaar imamo ko us ne paala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Saltanat chod kar wo aayi thi
Uf re fizza ki door andeshi
Tarbiyat uski fatima ne jo ki
Ho ke seefal chamak uthi chaandi
<<MINI>>
Qaak se noor bangayi fizza
Sar ta paa hoor ban gayi fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
Apni fitrat ko haq mizaaj kiya
Ghar me zehra ke kaam kaaj kiya
Hubbe zainab ko sar ka taaj kiya
Deen ki saltanat me raaj kiya
<<MINI>>
Haq ki nazrou me ba weqaar bani
Wo kaneezi me naa jawaar bani
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab jaha'n se guzar gayi zehra
Tha ajab haal gham se bachou ka
Uth gaya maa ka sar se jab saaya
Ghamzadou ko tha aasra tera
<<MINI>>
Aise aalam me bhi rafaaqat thi
Tu ne maa ki tarha se qidmat ki
<<DIVIDER>>
umme kulsoom aur zainab ki
Paasbaani me teri umr kati
Dil se hasnain par nisaar huwi
Sab ko ghere thi maamta teri
<<MINI>>
Teri ulfat ka rang anokha hai
Maa ki ankhou se sabko dekha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karti thi ghar ka roz aana
Ek din fizza ek din zehra
Yaa bano ka aur kaneezi ka
Ghar me zehra ke jo nahi paaya
<<MINI>>
Dil se hairaan ho gayi fizza
Ghar pe qurbaan ho gayi fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
Roniya tu ne bhi jo di fizza
Tujh ko bhi rab ne haq diya tera
Zikr tera bhi shukriya me kiya
Hal ata me bhi hai tera qissa
<<MINI>>
Teri qairaat qair kaamil hai
Sath tu panjetan ke shaamil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tujh pe toote sitam jo baade nabi
Fatima ki ajab haalat thi
Huwi jis dam wafaat mohsin ki
Tu ne ki fatima ki diljoyi
<<MINI>>
Gham ke toofa'n ko tune taala hai
Tu ne shehzadi ko sambhala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ranj o gham ke safar me sath rahi
Raah e qoufo qatar me sath rahi
Pyaas ki rehguzar me saath rahi
Tashnagi ke nagar me sath rahi
<<MINI>>
Karne qidmat ka haq ada pohanchi
Sath zainab ke karbala pohanchi
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima ka ujad ta ghar dekha
Jhule wale ko qoo'n me tar dekha
Zaqmi akbar ka bhi jigar dekha
Noke naiza pe sheh ka sar dekha
<<MINI>>
Tu shahe mashraqain ko royi
Karbala me hussain ko royi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye kaneeze batool nekh sifaat
Ranj o gham se mili na tujh ko behal
Sadme tu ne uthaye hai din raat
Shamil e karbala hai teri wafat
<<MINI>>
Rutba maa ka diya hai zainab ne
Tujh ko amma kaha hai zainab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Seh ke ranjo mehan jahaa'n se gayi
Zindagi bhar tu sogwaar rahi
Tanha tuj pe har bala ki huwi
Khoo'n rulaati hai bekasi teri
<<MINI>>
Ashk ankhou me bharke laye hai
Sab Azadar rone aaye hai
